decision.explanation: Document d2 directly states 'Athens 2004 Olympic Games, athletic festival held in Athens that took place August 13–29, 2004.' This clearly identifies Athens as the host city of the 2004 Olympic Games. Document d3 incorrectly states 'New York 2004 Olympic Games,' which is factually false and contradicted by known historical records and the actual Olympic history. Since the task requires relying on the provided sources and resolving contradictions based on contextual validity, 'New York' is removed as it is demonstrably irrelevant and contradicted by the correct source.
